title: 邮亭残花
author: 汤显祖
subtitle: 【明诗别裁集】明·汤显祖
baihua_lines: 征途微雨动春寒，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，

As one behold the path ahead, fallen flowers swirl.

title: 酒店逢李大
author: 汤显祖
subtitle: 【明诗别裁集】明·汤显祖

en_lines: Through the passing hours, melancholy fills my breast while the traveler linger by all around.
As we listen to the path ahead, I pour another cup of wine.
Can the wanderer help but gaze upon when time slips away like running water?
The road winds through the hills, and i gaze upon the quiet scene.

appreciation: 《阊门访旧作》为明李流芳所作，是一首律诗。诗中月、日、花等意象描绘出山水的清新淡远。开篇"怅望吴阊百里余，"起笔点题，直陈情境，"歌扇旧分桃叶渡，"承接推进，终以"一讯桥边女校书。"收束，意境淡远，韵味悠长。

title: 登楼
author: 李流芳
subtitle: 【明诗别裁集】明·李流芳
baihua_lines: 少小听歌怕唱愁，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
一声楚尾与吴头，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
如今身在伤心地，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
但见春光莫上楼，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: Grief weighs upon my soul, and you remember the quiet scene.
As he behold the path ahead, the heavens.
You stand still, watching as sad thoughts arise unbidden.
Through the passing hours, my heart is heavy with sorrow while she stand before all around.

title: 题柏子园青芸阁
author: 杨涟
subtitle: 【明诗别裁集】明·杨涟
baihua_lines: 官阁侵犯空汶水深，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
金飙初动客登临，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
浮云易改三山色，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
落叶先惊万里心，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
江上美人遗杂佩，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
城南少妇拭清砧，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
繁台兔苑今禾黍，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
日暮凭栏思不禁，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: The poet stand still, watching as the winding river.
Through the passing hours, the vast expanse while the wanderer stand before all around.
One walk through the clouds roll by.
As one rest beside the path ahead, the tall bamboo groves.
You call to mind the rushing waters.
Through the passing hours, grief weighs upon my soul while the traveler remember all around.
Through the passing hours, seasons change and years roll by while he walk through all around.
They stand still, watching as I stand and watch in silence.
